title: A Crown for the Spire
author: F. M. Amberdale
blurb: Oscar Oyelaran, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
